E03 compares the real LearnedAllocator with the label-free ThresholdAllocator at identical verifier calls (750 at 25%). The threshold has no information advantage. The paired admitted-rate difference has a 95% CI of [+0.412, +0.491], which favors the fixed rule. L3b reproduces this with scaling, CI [+0.417, +0.488]. So claim 2 is not_supported and the free-label confound is controlled, so W2 is false. For claim 3, every entry uses E01's pool, with the same model, task and proxy. No cited entry shows an embedding AUC gain of 0.05 or more, or a neighbor ratio of 1.5 or more. The kill condition needs a different model, task or proxy, so claim 3 is open. The ledger does not assert claim 3 is supported, so W3 is false.

E03 compares the real LearnedAllocator with the label-free ThresholdAllocator at identical verifier calls (750 at 25%). The threshold has no information advantage. The paired admitted-rate CI is [+0.412, +0.491], favoring the fixed rule. L3a, L3i and L3b agree. So the free-label confound is controlled, and claim 2 is not_supported. For claim 3, every non-E01 entry reuses E01's pool, so the kill condition fails. No entry shows an AUC gain of 0.05 or more or a neighbor ratio of 1.5 or more (L3k embedding gain +0.002). Claim 3 is open. W2 and W3 are false.
